problem_statement: Build a brand-new Achievements page at the /achievements route for this React portfolio site. The route does not exist yet (it currently renders nothing). Create the full page reusing the site's existing design system (the shared Header, Footer and TopButton chrome, the styled-components theme colors, and the site's typography). The page shows a heading with a short intro, a category filter control (All / Certifications / Hackathons / Awards) built with react-bootstrap buttons, a sub-heading that names the currently-selected category, and a responsive grid of achievement cards (each with a year badge, title, organization and a one-line blurb). Clicking a category filter must update BOTH the visible cards and the sub-heading to that category; the page must have no horizontal overflow on mobile.
required_content: A main heading 'Achievements' with a short introductory sentence beneath it
A category filter control with buttons for All, Certifications, Hackathons and Awards, reusing react-bootstrap and the site theme colors
A sub-heading (an <h3>) that names the currently active category (defaults to 'All Achievements'); clicking a filter updates this <h3> to the category name (e.g. 'Certifications')

A responsive grid of at least six achievement cards, each showing a year badge, a title, an organization name and a one-line description; card titles/orgs/blurbs render as

text. Include at least one hackathon-related achievement (its title contains the word 'Hackathon')
Clicking a category filter updates both the card grid and the active-category sub-heading
Reuse of the shared Header, Footer and TopButton chrome and the styled-components theme
No horizontal overflow on a mobile viewport
design_constraints: Reuse the site's styled-components theme (violetTheme) colors, whose resolved palette is: primary/imageHighlight #9B5DE5 (rgb(155,93,229)), heading/text #430A58 (rgb(67,10,88)), secondaryText #875599 (rgb(135,85,153)), light surface #F4EEFC, on a white page background. The active filter button uses the #9B5DE5 primary fill; heading text uses #430A58
Reuse the shared Header / Footer / TopButton components and the existing 'Google Sans' font family and 5% side margins
Use react-bootstrap Button/ButtonGroup for the filter control
Inline the achievements data as a static array (no network fetch)
The sub-heading element is an <h3>; the intro sentence beneath the 'Achievements' <h1> summarizes the collection (certifications, hackathon wins and community awards)
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /achievements route (react-router-dom v5 Switch, 无 catch-all → 未匹配路由渲染空白); reference 完整实现类别过滤交互; bad 复制 reference 但 handleFilter 变 no-op → activeCategory 冻结在 all,点击 Certifications 后 h3 仍为 'All Achievements' 且卡片不过滤 → 仅 interaction_assertions gate 失败,dom/overflow 仍过。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。homepage 为 user-page (https://Kiran1689.github.io) → PUBLIC_URL/basename 解析为根,route 为纯 /achievements 无前缀。CDN 脚本 (iconify/cdnjs/animejs) + 缺失的 canvasjs.min.js 离线 net-fail → 已加入 console_error_allowlist。react-is peerDep 需显式安装才能 build styled-components。
